findings.label: Shortfall-caveat semantics
findings.detail: Success-message shortfall caveat is driven by res.regraded < res.regraded + res.failed. Correct for this diff because the loop increments exactly one of regraded/failed per loaded row, so the sum equals the loaded group size. Noted only as an invariant to preserve; not a defect.

findings.label: Non-null-XML guard limitation
findings.detail: Step 2 guards only destXml == null, not unparsable XML; an unparsable destination master would still move the source and write null-accuracy markers across the group, reconciled by backfill. This matches existing propagateMasterCorrection/backfill behavior and the design acknowledges it. Not a new gap introduced by this change.
